hypotheses.R1_known_reads_are_early_useful: The best predeclared readable chart reaches at least 0.50 response fidelity for every target at boundary 6.
hypotheses.R2_known_reads_beat_random: The best readable chart exceeds the matched random-position chart by at least 0.10 in every target-boundary cell.
hypotheses.R3_learned_positions_beat_random: The candidate-independent Fisher-position chart exceeds its matched random-position chart by at least 0.15 in every target-boundary cell.
hypotheses.R4_position_chart_is_sampling_stable: Independent Fisher sketches have leading-8 positional-subspace overlap at least 0.70 in every context and boundary.
hypotheses.R5_unrestricted_joint_has_unexplained_st: The joint rank-128 chart exceeds every readable factorized chart by at least 0.10 in at least one target-boundary cell.
hypotheses.R6_some_known_read_approaches_joint: A readable factorized chart is within 0.10 of joint rank 128 in at least half of target-boundary cells.
